title: Work IQ: agents upload files and content to Microsoft 365
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented Work IQ controls and consumption licensing are supported. Upload-specific destinations, defaults and transfer details remain undocumented in the sources searched. Add the source for the separate human-in-the-loop roadmap entry.
